widgets_values: {'prompt': 'Cinematic high-end business technology finance scene, color palette of warm gold, rose gold, and deep space blue gradient. Vertical tripartite layout (9:16 portrait), three flat electronic screens arranged vertically from top to bottom, non-overlapping, with slight front-middle-back depth staggering. Each screen seamlessly integrates with the background (faint halo matching ambient light at edges, harmonious color transition, highlight direction consistent with top-left side backlight, rear screens appropriately blurred, no harsh borders). Top screen: hexagonal shape, ice blue LCD matte screen, displaying a stylized battery icon with a prominent "207" inside and a "+50%" arrow (glowing effect). Text on screen: "净利润 207亿". Text effect: raised embossment (larger text, high relief with bright edges, 3D side thickness). Central screen: downward-sloping parallelogram, rose gold LED flexible screen, displaying a downward-trending bar chart with "-10%" label (glowing bars). Text on screen: "环比下降 10%". Text effect: concave engraving (smaller text, clear inner shadow). Bottom screen: rectangular shape with a mining pickaxe icon integrated into one corner, dark gold OLED mirror screen, displaying the number "300" with a currency symbol and light rays pointing towards a stylized lithium crystal (glowing effect). Text on screen: "投资布局 300亿". Text effect: raised embossment. Background scene: Blurred shallow depth of field scene of a high-tech new energy vehicle manufacturing or R&D center (adapted for portrait composition). Lighting: Top-left side backlight casting soft reflections and localized highlights on screen surfaces. Image quality: 2K resolution (9:16 portrait), cinematic film grain, shadow contrast ≥30%, text edge blur ≤5px. Negative constraints: No text overlap, no repeated text or numbers, no raised screen bezels, no color or lighting disconnect between screens and background, no text on screens other than the specified labels.'}
